methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page (accessed 2026-06-14). SerpApi pricing fetched directly from serpapi.com/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.
